description: Recent recorded changes to a visa's rules or to its official source page, newest first, for one visa or every visa in a country. Each change names the fields that moved, the source and the date. Whether a change is proposed or in force is only stated when a source says so.

country.description: Lowercase destination country code, e.g. 'de', 'ca' or 'uk'. 'gb' also works for the UK.

since_days.description: How many days back to look, e.g. 90. Default 90.

visa_id.description: Transita visa id, e.g. 'uk-skilled-worker'. Get ids from transita_match_visas or transita_list_visas.

name: transita_rule_changes
title: Rule changes
